notablePrerequisites: A permanent you control has left the battlefield this turn.
easyPrerequisites: Iceberg has at least one ice counter on it.
description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying its mana cost.
Inexorable Tide and Equilibrium trigger.
Resolve the Inexorable Tide trigger, causing you to proliferate, thus putting an ice counter on Iceberg.
Holding priority, activate Iceberg's second ability by removing an ice counter, adding {C}.
Resolve the Equilibrium trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Hidden Herbalists from the battlefield to your hand.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Hidden Herbalists by paying its mana cost.
Inexorable Tide and Equilibrium trigger.
Resolve the Inexorable Tide trigger, causing you to proliferate, thus putting an ice counter on Iceberg.
Holding priority, activate Iceberg's second ability by removing an ice counter, adding {C}.
Resolve the Equilibrium trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Priest of Urabrask from the battlefield to your hand.
When Hidden Herbalists enters, it triggers, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.
